entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thanks for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return an item. Order number is VF789012.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me just pull that up... I see the order for the Mountain Bike shoes. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them?
They don't work for me. They're giving me blisters on long rides. I just want to start the return process for a refund.
I'm sorry to hear that the fit is causing blisters. Just to be sure, is it a technical fault with the shoe itself, or more of a preference and fit issue?
Look, I don't have time to diagnose it. The cycling shoes don't fit my feet. The position of the cleats feels fine, but the heel cup is the problem. Can I return them or not?

Yes, absolutely. I just needed to confirm the reason. Let me check the purchase date... It looks like they were delivered 69 days ago. According to our policy, you have 90 days for a return, so you are well within the window. I am processing your full refund now. I've just sent the return shipping label to your email on file.
Okay, great. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
